title: Docs-only pull requests merge on any GitHub plan
summary: With **Docs auto-merge** on, Spec Control now waits until a pull request that only changes files under `openspec/` is mergeable and its checks pass, then asks your agent to merge it — so it works on free private repositories too, without GitHub's auto-merge. A new **Merge** action in a session's console asks the agent to merge any ready pull request by hand.
